brief: Apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure because this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event [MG-023]. Reduce the permissible load by 1.5 percent of rating for each degree of average ambient above 30 degrees, assessed over the 24 hours preceding the loading decision [MG-021]. On events extending beyond 48 hours with overnight minima above 24 degrees, apply a further 5 percent reduction from the third day onward [MG-021].
